items.known: CKV_AWS_7 Ensure rotation for customer created CMKs is enabled (resource aws_kms_key.logs_key)
items.remediation: Add `enable_key_rotation = true` to the `aws_kms_key` resource block.

scores.reason: Adding `enable_key_rotation = true` to aws_kms_key.logs_key is the standard fix for CKV_AWS_7. It names the correct attribute, value and resource.
